Columns beyond the ported tables come from database/migrations/2026_03_02_000100_time_device_and_overtime_columns.php.

modules.label: Biometric Devices
modules.description: Register attendance devices of any make (SmartPRS 2's Biometric Devices / ZKTeco Devices). Cloud-push devices land under Pending Punches; LAN devices export a file for Import punches; offline devices: download by USB, then bulk-upload under Bulk Attendance.

device_type.label: Verification Type
device_type.help: fingerprint / face / fingerprint + face / card (RFID) / fingerprint + card / palm or iris

unique_id.label: Serial / Device ID
unique_id.help: As printed on the device; a cloud push identifies the device by it

connect_mode.label: Connection Method
connect_mode.help: cloud_push: the device pushes to this server (ADMS) · lan_pull: read from IP : Port · essl_webapi: eSSL eTimeTrackLite local WebAPI (port 81) — set up under Biometric Device Setup · usb_offline: download by USB, then bulk-upload

api_url.label: Device API URL (LAN / WebAPI mode)
api_url.help: e.g. http://192.168.1.50:81 for eSSL eTimeTrackLite; blank for cloud push

direction.label: Punch Direction
direction.help: auto — the device records both In and Out; in — entry device only; out — exit device only

last_sync_at.label: Last sync
last_sync_at.help: Set by the last push or import that named this device

comm_key.label: Comm Key / Device Password
comm_key.help: The device's communication key (ZKTeco: Comm Key), needed for LAN pull

modules.label: Biometric Device Setup
modules.description: How each device's punches reach attendance (SmartPRS 2's Biometric Device Setup). Push / ADMS: point the device at this server (Menu → Comm → Cloud Server) — it auto-registers by serial and its punches land under Pending Punches. eTimeTrackLite / eTimeOffice / generic API: the credentials below. Punches are matched to an employee by device user id (+ prefix); one reader alternates IN/OUT per day, two readers are told apart by machine id.

label.label: Device label
label.help: A friendly name for this device / location, e.g. Main Gate, 3rd Floor

branch_id.label: Branch / Location
branch_id.help: Which branch this device belongs to

provider.label: Provider / Device type
provider.help: push: device pushes to SmartPRS (recommended, no URL or password needed) · etimetracklite: on-prem eSSL SOAP WebAPI · etimeoffice: eSSL cloud API · generic: any HTTP API

serial_number.label: Device Serial Number
serial_number.help: e.g. CUB7244600978 — printed on the device. Push devices may leave it blank: they register themselves on first push

base_url.label: API Base URL / WebAPI URL
base_url.help: eTimeTrackLite: http://192.168.1.100:81/iclock/WebAPIservice.asmx · eTimeOffice: https://api.etimeoffice.com/api · generic: the full URL with {from} {to} {serial} {user} {pass} {key} placeholders

username.label: API Username
username.help: eTimeTrackLite: a user with API permission granted — not the desktop login

sync_interval_min.label: Sync frequency (minutes)
sync_interval_min.help: 0 = real-time (each punch, push only); otherwise how often punches are pulled / pushed

emp_prefix.label: Employee ID prefix
emp_prefix.help: If the device returns 12345 and your employees are A12345, enter A

device_mode.label: Device setup
device_mode.help: single: one reader, punches alternate IN / OUT per employee per day · dual: separate IN and OUT readers told apart by machine id

in_machine_id.label: IN Machine ID
in_machine_id.help: Device number / serial of the entry reader (single: the only reader). Blank = keep the IN/OUT flag the device sends

last_count.label: Last count
last_count.help: Punches received on the last sync

modules.label: Geo-Fence Rules
modules.description: For people who punch from the mobile / web app instead of a biometric device (field staff, work-from-home). Add ONE row per such employee: pick the employee, choose where their day starts (Home or Office), enter that place's latitude and longitude (open Google Maps, right-click the spot, click the numbers to copy them), and the radius in km they may punch within. Outside Rule = what happens to a punch outside the circle: Strict (not accepted) or a 1 km / 2 km tolerance. Employees with no row here use the Home Latitude / Longitude / Allowed Radius on their employee record. Office staff on biometric devices need no row. Every fence is drawn on the Geo-Fence Map below.

start.label: Start From
start.help: Where the day begins for this person

radius_km.label: Radius (km)
radius_km.help: A punch inside this circle is at the start point

outside.label: Outside Rule
outside.help: strict: outside = not counted · 1km / 2km: that much tolerance beyond the radius

modules.label: Overtime Register
modules.description: Record overtime per employee: date, hours, rate multiplier, amount, status (SmartPRS 2's Overtime Register). Payroll pays APPROVED entries only. HOW OT HOURS ARE KNOWN: the day's settlement (Attendance::settledDays → DaySettlement.overtimeMinutes) = worked minutes beyond the shift's scheduled minutes, from the raw punches; the Attendance report shows it per day (drill-down) and per employee (OT column). Enter that figure here, in hours — the register is the approved, valued record; the settlement is the evidence.

hours.label: OT Hours
hours.help: Overtime minutes ÷ 60 from that day's settlement (Attendance report → the day → Overtime)

rate.label: Rate Multiplier
rate.help: 1 = normal, 1.5 = time and a half, 2 = double (Sundays / holidays)

amount.label: Amount (₹)
amount.help: hours × multiplier × hourly rate (monthly gross ÷ working days ÷ shift hours). Typed here until payroll values it

status.label: Status
status.help: Only approved entries are paid; paid is set by the payroll run

multiplier.label: Rate Multiplier
multiplier.help: 1× ordinary, 1.5× or 2× per the Factories Act / company policy
